summary: Intermap Technologies filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a subcontract award from a U.S. Department of Defense prime contractor for a research program on GPS-denied navigation. No financial terms, stake percentage, price per share, premium, or board recommendation are disclosed. The filing is a routine disclosure of a government contract award under a foreign private issuer's continuous reporting obligations. There is no merger, acquisition, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The press release describes ordinary-course business development. What to watch: the filing has no actionable special-situation content.
